output.explanation: NIG-US invoice INV-US-100438 (line NIG-US:4471049, USD 21,280.00 secondment M. Smith, P-24050) matches NIG-AE payable NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031267 exactly: same amount, same project, and reference 100438 appears on the buyer line. The buyer line's counterparty, however, is booked as NorthStar Infrastruktur GmbH (NIG-DE) instead of NIG-US, so the payable sits against the wrong IC partner.
output.recommended_action: NIG-AE should reclassify the payable on ICV-AE-031267 from counterparty NIG-DE to NIG-US in the October 2026 period.
output.adjustment_description: Debit IC payable – NIG-DE and credit IC payable – NIG-US for USD 21,280.00 to move the secondment invoice INV-US-100438 to the correct intercompany partner.
